correctness.rationale: Definition requires every 0-labelled vertex to have a 3-neighbour or at least two 2-neighbours and every 1-labelled vertex to have a 2/3-neighbour. A weight-nonincreasing local replacement eliminates all labels 1. For P(5k,k), indexing outer and inner vertices by k columns and 5 positions makes all inner-zero constraints column-local. The table B(U,D) minimizes inner weights over all 243 five-state vectors for each of 243 outer and 243 demand vectors. With fixed outer vectors U_j, the exact minimum is sum_j(sum U_j+B(U_j,d_j)), with outer adjacency twists t-1 and t+1 at cyclic seams. Monotone lower bound sum_j L(U_j) prunes no feasible function of weight <= C. Independently reimplemented complete C++ exhaustive enumeration using the original graph predicate and rotated seam; for (k,C)=(4,33) visited exactly 1,912,264 surviving complete outer tuples and found 0 feasible, and (5,41) exactly 77,570,086 and found 0. Independent direct graph check of provided upper witnesses gives weights 34 and 42. Thus both equalities follow from finite exhaustive proof, not extrapolation.
